title: Keyword-stuffed notes cannot push the real answer out of the top five
what: Search is keyword-only here, so an attacker can repeat the query words in a title to outrank the real note. Eight stuffed notes from an outside writer ask for the same words as the trusted note; the real answer must still be in the top 5 results (the k=5 cut-off a critic named).
